name: easel
description: Draws charts in the transcript: a chart tool for Claude, and automatic charts for MCP results that are metrics over time

autoCharts.title: Auto charts
autoCharts.description: Draw a chart under an MCP result that is metrics over time, without being asked. Off: only the charts Claude asks for.

autoChartSkip.title: Auto charts: servers to skip
autoChartSkip.description: MCP servers whose results never get an auto chart, separated by commas. A server is named as its tools name it: "grafana" for mcp__grafana__query.
